A [[Tammuz-an (species)/Legends|Tammuz-an]] '''individual''' was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mon Julpa]]. He was a member of the royal family on [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] and taught his son about a secret entrance into the dungeon of the [[royal castle]]. The man had [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point before [[Mon Julpa]] returned to Tammuz-an, as his son and the [[Vizier/Legends|Vizier]] [[Ko Zatec-Cha]] were the only contenders to the throne.<ref name="Droids" />
